answer.says: Ramesh, I have paid the wages and the grocery accounts. Please see that the kitchen is ready for breakfast shortly. I intend to sit on the verandah for a moment to read the papers before I eat.
answer.thought: The cash leaves my pocket with a finality that is difficult to reconcile with the state's claim on my vouchers, yet the transaction is complete and the man is satisfied. I will not dwell on the friction of the money now; I must first observe what the world is doing while I am here.
